common.auth_error_message: The cookie for **{gamer_tag}** has expired. Copy a fresh cookie from your browser (with its User-Agent) and paste it in the integration options.
common.mapping_message: Game **{game}** ({platform}) not matching. Publisher: {publisher}. Add `"{game}": "TrueAchievements name"` to `trueachievements/mapping.json` and press the **Reload game mapping** button.

data_description.file_only: Do not download anything from Home Assistant: only read the CSV file (sent by the TrueAchievements Sync Firefox extension, for example). No cookie is needed.
data_description.gamertoken: Optional. Your full cookie string (all name=value; pairs) copied from your browser. Not needed in local file only mode.
data_description.user_agent: Optional. The exact User-Agent of the browser the cookie was copied from (run navigator.userAgent in the browser console). Leave empty to use the default.

user.description: Enter your TrueAchievements credentials. You can find your GamerID in your profile URL and your GamerToken in your cookies (TrueGamingIdentity).
